_about: Public-domain H. Clay Trumbull (Henry Clay Trumbull, 1830-1903), editor of The Sunday School Times, for the Word Hoard: Kadesh-Barnea (1884), The Blood Covenant (1885), Friendship the Master-Passion (1892), Studies in Oriental Social Life (1894), The Threshold Covenant (1896), Prayer: Its Nature and Scope (copyright 1896) and The Covenant of Salt (1899), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 36 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

hctrumbull-kadesh-barnea: Kadesh-Barnea: Its Importance and Probable Site, with the Story of a Hunt for It (New York: Charles Scribner's Sons, 1884)
hctrumbull-blood-covenant: The Blood Covenant: A Primitive Rite and Its Bearings on Scripture (New York: Charles Scribner's Sons, 1885)
hctrumbull-friendship: Friendship the Master-Passion (Philadelphia: John D. Wattles, 1892)
hctrumbull-oriental-social-life: Studies in Oriental Social Life and Gleams from the East on the Sacred Page (Philadelphia: John D. Wattles, 1894)
hctrumbull-threshold-covenant: The Threshold Covenant, or The Beginning of Religious Rites (New York: Charles Scribner's Sons, 1896)
hctrumbull-prayer: Prayer: Its Nature and Scope (New York, Chicago, Toronto: Fleming H. Revell; copyright 1896)
hctrumbull-covenant-salt: The Covenant of Salt, as Based on the Significance and Symbolism of Salt in Primitive Thought (New York: Charles Scribner's Sons, 1899)

_alternates.hctrumbull-copies: PG 48236, 49216 and 46212 (Blood Covenant, Threshold Covenant, Covenant of Salt, same Scribner's imprints); other Kadesh-Barnea copies (one the London Hodder edition, catalogued as Scribner); A Lie Never Justifiable (PG 10591) and Hints on Child-Training (PG 57569), title pages not read
